## ⚡ The Developer Primitives Suite

High-performance, deterministic developer tools engineered for autonomous AI agents, context window compression, and automated data pipelines.

| Primitive | Focus & Protocol | Latency / Savings | 1-Click Installation |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **[TokenMarkdown](https://github.com/quitegoodproject/tokenmarkdown)** | Sub-150ms Web-to-AST Markdown for LLM Context | **⚡ 148ms (95% Context Compression)** | `npx -y tokenmarkdown-mcp` |
| **[TokenEnrich](https://github.com/quitegoodproject/tokenenrich)** | Sub-140ms ~180-Token Firmographics & Mailbox Checks | **⚡ 138ms (~180 Tokens)** | `npx -y @quitegoodproject/tokenenrich-mcp` |

## 🔌 Core Architectural Invariants (RFC-2601)

1. **Deterministic Over Probabilistic**: Fixed token budgets, deterministic error codes, and strict JSON schemas.
2. **Context Window Optimization**: Eliminates 95%+ of prompt bloat to keep LLM context budgets lean and reasoning accurate.
3. **Zero Third-Party Vendor Latency**: Built directly on edge sockets, zero-cost wire DNS resolvers, and mathematical algorithms.
